description: What `ascribe permalinks sync` does to the list.

aliased.description:
The names moved to another permalink recorded, new or leading
somewhere new, by name.

ascribe_version.description: The version of Ascribe that wrote it.

changed.description: Whether the list's file changes: it's new, or its text differs.

created.description: Whether the project had no list, so this makes one.

forwarded.description:
The names moved to a page recorded, new or leading somewhere new, by
name.

moved.description: The names whose place changed, by name.

removed.description:
The names the list keeps that the project no longer has, by name.
`ascribe check` warns about each.

retired.description: The retired permalinks recorded, new or with a new reason, by name.

schema_version.description:
The version of this schema. It changes only when a field is removed
or changes meaning.

title: PermalinksSyncReport
